title: SDK catalog curation and cohort gates
creator: Priya Desai
description: Goal: build a lightweight, repeatable playbook and tracking dashboard that curates SDKs, docs, and quickstarts into onboarding cohorts with measurable gates. This initiative ties to DX OKR: Increase first-week active SDK integrators by 35% and reduce time-to-first-API-call by 25% for new signups. Scope: 1) Define catalog taxonomy (language, sample-app maturity, recommended quickstarts), 2) Create cohort gate definitions (signal thresholds for 'Ready', 'Trial', 'Pilot'), 3) Instrument onboarding telemetry (funnel events + cohort labels), 4) Wire a dashboard for initiative leads to monitor adoption, regressions, and rollouts, 5) Produce a single-page playbook for solutions and SEs to run cohort-driven onboarding experiments.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog taxonomy documented and reviewed by Eng + DX
Cohort gate thresholds defined with example signals (e.g., token usage, sample app run, docs viewed)
Telemetry events emitted for cohort transitions and available in analytics workspace
Dashboard (Segment/Looker/Metabase) with cohort conversion and retention metrics
Playbook published in Confluence with runbook and checklist for cohort experiments
